rules.fixedCommit: must be a real commit and must contain the file the entry's own lifecycle.regressionCommand promises to run
rules.verifiedCommit: must be a real commit that descends from fixedCommit; it names the head whose exact-SHA Actions readback came back green
rules.null: an unverified fix stays null, and a PASS record with no fixedCommit is listed as owed rather than left silently unbound
